name: @qf-jarvis/communication-authorization-runtime
description: QF Jarvis communication authorization correlation runtime (QFJ-P08, ADR-0083). One pure function: given a CommunicationRequestV1, the CommunicationAuthorizationV1 QuickFurno Core returned, and optional approval evidence, prove the artifacts belong together and return a frozen OBSERVATION. It asks Core nothing, sends nothing, persists nothing, and holds no consent, opt-out, STOP, suppression or eligibility state of its own -- all of which belong to the QuickFurno Communication Core. A Core refusal is an ordinary authoritative observation: founder approval does not override an opt-out. An authorized outcome requires a re-proved, APPROVED per-action approval verdict, and the result carries no canSend, canExecute, isAuthorized, consentValid or validUntil, because Core's decision is a historical fact and not a future permission slip -- eligibility is revalidated at execution time, elsewhere. Depends on @qf-jarvis/contracts and @qf-jarvis/approval-runtime only.
